crosswalks.historical_boundary: Fayyum provincial villages and canal network in the 1245 register
crosswalks.resolution_method: digitize the published Fayyum village/canal map and overlay it against EU5 polygons
required_actions: obtain or digitize the historical village and canal boundary
quantify how much of the game Fayyum location is covered
do not convert taxes to people without a documented multiplier
blocking_reasons: single EU5 location is broader than the village register geography
register contains fiscal and irrigation data but no total headcount
modern lake and canal geometry cannot be assumed historical

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Assessed Nile Valley and Delta cadastral corridor
crosswalks.resolution_method: map assessed feddan corridor and Fayyum/Delta administrative limits onto calibrated EU5 geometry
required_actions: separate habitable floodplain from desert and urban export corridors
compare historical cadastral boundary with region selector
keep population reconstruction validation-only
blocking_reasons: region selector is broader than the documented cadastre

crosswalks.resolution_method: none until fiscal corridor and plague-period boundaries are independently reconstructed
required_actions: retain as rejected
do not use the selector as evidence of local capacity

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Mapungubwe Cultural Landscape including dependent settlement area
crosswalks.resolution_method: obtain UNESCO/SANParks cultural-landscape polygon and overlay it with the Limpopo game location
required_actions: quantify cultural-landscape overlap
retain the 9,000 figure as a one-sided lower bound only
separate trade/state settlement from intrinsic rural capacity
blocking_reasons: game location is broader than the heritage landscape

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Jenné-jeno and Middle Niger settlement cluster with rural floodplain hinterland
crosswalks.resolution_method: map published Middle Niger survey polygons and settlement cluster onto EU5 provinces/locations
required_actions: obtain a survey polygon rather than a city point
separate rural settlement from the urban node
do not convert site hectares to people

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Great Zimbabwe archaeological site and phase occupation areas
crosswalks.resolution_method: never use as surrounding-land capacity; preserve as an urban negative control
required_actions: keep population interval site-only
exclude from aggregate capacity likelihood
use only to detect city-to-land extrapolation errors
blocking_reasons: archaeological site is much smaller than game location
site population is not land capacity

crosswalks.resolution_method: digitize archaeological survey and crop/terrace landscape around Lalibela before any population work
required_actions: retain as qualitative food-system evidence
separate royal/monastic construction from rural support
do not infer population from monument scale

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Timbuktu, Gao, and Kano urban/trade nodes
crosswalks.resolution_method: no quantitative crosswalk until rural food hinterlands and source intervals are identified
required_actions: keep rejected
do not substitute city locations for rural systems
look for village/tax/archaeological surveys before reconsideration

crosswalks.resolution_method: not applicable; continental extrapolation is outside the evidence policy
required_actions: retain rejected
replace with local independently sourced packets
never use a continental balancing target
